typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Domain as string,
		Care_Coord_Primary_Key as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Domain = Domain) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(Create_Date = currentTimestamp(),
		Care_Coordinator_ID = left(replace(replace(Care_Coord_Primary_Key, toString('\"'), toString('')), toString(' '), toString('')), 10),
		Domain_ID = replace(replace(Domain, toString('\"'), toString('')), toString(' '), toString('')),
		FileName = right($ImportFile, locate('\\', reverse($ImportFile), 1) - 1)) ~> DeriveFields
DeriveFields split(length(Care_Coordinator_ID) < 10,iifNull(Domain_ID,'') == '',iifNull(Care_Coordinator_ID,'') == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(CCIDislessthan10chars,DomainIDisNULL,CCIDisnull,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive() ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount sink(input(
		Care_Coordinator_ID as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FileName as string,
		Domain_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Care_Coordinator_ID,
		CREATE_DATE = Create_Date,
		FileName,
		Domain_ID)) ~> KanCareCCIDLookuptable
